activities.name: Zakouma National Park
activities.note: the floodplains go under water in the rains, getting around becomes virtually impossible and the park closes to visitors

windows.reason: early dry season: relatively cool, with the animals still spread out
outlying water dries up and game concentrates, peaking in March and April when it passes 40°C
the last of the dry season before the rains close the park

activities.name: Ennedi massif expeditions
activities.note: the long dry season runs October to June; the July to September rains can be surprisingly heavy

windows.reason: the best months for Ennedi; group expeditions depart November to March

activities.name: Wodaabe Gerewol
activities.note: the one time each year the Wodaabe groups gather; the site follows the herders and is fixed late

windows.reason: held at the end of the rainy season, around the last week of September and the start of October
